contributorNotInProject: Only project members can be added as collaborators
pdfDraftNotOpen: Drafting from a PDF isn't available yet. Try again later.
pdfScanFallbackFailed: Page {page} is a scan (no text layer). It was rendered as an image and sent to the model, but the model still couldn't read anything usable ({detail}).
pdfScannedPageNoVision: Page {page} has no text layer (a scan or image page), and rendering it as an image won't help: the current drafting model {model} can't read images. Switch to a drafting model that can, then try again.
submissionChallengeEnded: This challenge has ended, so no work can be handed in
submissionClaimNotApproved: Your claim must be approved before you can hand work in
submissionPastDeadline: Your submission deadline has passed, so no version can be handed in or changed. Ask the challenge's author to extend it
taskCreatedByPerson: Only a person can create a task this way
taskOpeningNotFailed: Drafting the task's doc has not failed; there is nothing to retry
taskOwnSessionCloses: Only the task's owner, or the task's own session, can close it
taskOwnerNotInProject: A task can only be handed to a project member
taskOwnerOnly: Only the task's owner can do this
taskParticipantsOnly: Only the task's owner and collaborators can talk to its AI teammate here
taskTitleTooLong: This title doesn't fit one sidebar line: a line holds about {limit} half-width characters (a CJK character counts as 2) and this one is {now}. Write a shorter one and try again.
teammateTaskByTeammate: Only an AI teammate creates tasks here
